source_text: If it isn’t the man of the hour.

structure.raw_value: PlFlOp.If it isn’t the man of the hour.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlOp.If it isn’t the man of the hour."

translation: Jeśli to nie człowiek godziny.

source_text: 1Hero, that’s what you’re wearing in the interview?

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.1Hero, that’s what you’re wearing in the interview?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.1Hero, that’s what you’re wearing in the interview?"

translation: 1Hero, w tym chcesz wystąpić w wywiadzie?

source_text: No worries. We’ll get him changed up.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.No worries. We’ll get him changed up.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.No worries. We’ll get him changed up."

translation: Bez obaw. Przebierzemy go.

source_text: Make sure lighting fixed the blow out.

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.Make sure lighting fixed the blow out.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.Make sure lighting fixed the blow out."

translation: Upewnij się, że oświetlenie naprawiło prześwietlenie.

source_text: No more blaming it on the camera man.

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx.No more blaming it on the camera man.
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx.No more blaming it on the camera man."

translation: Koniec z zwalaniem na kamerzystę.

source_text: Sorry. Busy morning.

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp.Sorry. Busy morning.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp.Sorry. Busy morning."

translation: Przepraszam. Zajęty poranek.

source_text: Detective Canmore, what can I call you? Mr. Canmore?

structure.raw_value: PlFlOp.Detective Canmore, what can I call you? Mr. Canmore?
structure.script_literal: "PlFlOp.Detective Canmore, what can I call you? Mr. Canmore?"

translation: Detektywie Canmore, jak mam się do pana zwracać? Panie Canmore?

source_text: 1Hero is fine.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.1Hero is fine.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.1Hero is fine."

translation: 1Hero wystarczy.

source_text: Hi, 1Hero. I’m Paul. I’m the producer of Kimberly’s show.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Hi, 1Hero. I’m Paul. I’m the producer of Kimberly’s show.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Hi, 1Hero. I’m Paul. I’m the producer of Kimberly’s show."

translation: Cześć, 1Hero. Jestem Paul. Jestem producentem programu Kimberly.

source_text: Let’s get you to the changing rooms.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.Let’s get you to the changing rooms.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.Let’s get you to the changing rooms."

translation: Zaprowadźmy cię do garderoby.

source_text: Bring the commissioner to the studio.

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp.Bring the commissioner to the studio.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp.Bring the commissioner to the studio."

translation: Przyprowadźcie panią komisarz do studia.

source_text: Clean him up nice, Paul.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Clean him up nice, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Clean him up nice, Paul."

translation: Doprowadź go do porządku, Paul.

source_text: We always do, Commish.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.We always do, Commish.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.We always do, Commish."

translation: Zawsze, pani komisarz.

source_text: Come on. We’re crunched for time.

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.Come on. We’re crunched for time.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.Come on. We’re crunched for time."

translation: Chodź. Goni nas czas.

source_text: I’ve put all your junk in this box and now you have to take your stuff and leave.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve put all your junk in this box and now you have to take your stuff and leave.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve put all your junk in this box and now you have to take your stuff and leave."

translation: Wpakowałem wszystkie twoje graty do tego pudła i teraz musisz zabrać swoje rzeczy i wyjść.

source_text: Are you firing me?!

structure.raw_value: NPC.Are you firing me?!
structure.script_literal: "NPC.Are you firing me?!"

translation: Wyrzucasz mnie!?

source_text: Sorry. But, that’s life.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Sorry. But, that’s life.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Sorry. But, that’s life."

translation: Przepraszam. Ale takie jest życie.

source_text: Welcome back, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Welcome back, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Welcome back, 1Hero."

translation: Witaj ponownie, 1Hero.

source_text: I wanted to get here early. I need to change.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I wanted to get here early. I need to change.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I wanted to get here early. I need to change."

translation: Chciałem przyjść wcześniej. Muszę się przebrać.

source_text: We got you covered. Kimberly wants to meet with you now.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.We got you covered. Kimberly wants to meet with you now.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.We got you covered. Kimberly wants to meet with you now."

translation: Mamy wszystko gotowe. Kimberly chce się teraz z tobą spotkać.

source_text: Don’t worry, 1Hero. She’s got something to show you. Head down the hall. I’ll see you on set.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.Don’t worry, 1Hero. She’s got something to show you. Head down the hall. I’ll see you on set.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.Don’t worry, 1Hero. She’s got something to show you. Head down the hall. I’ll see you on set."

translation: Bez obaw, 1Hero. Ma ci coś do pokazania. Idź korytarzem. Zobaczymy się na planie.

source_text: Hey! What gives!?

structure.raw_value: McAnOpNo1.Hey! What gives!?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOpNo1.Hey! What gives!?"

translation: Hej! O co chodzi!?

source_text: Sorry, 1Hero. But someone had to break this story.

structure.raw_value: KiFlExNo4.Sorry, 1Hero. But someone had to break this story.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlExNo4.Sorry, 1Hero. But someone had to break this story."

translation: Przepraszam, 1Hero. Ale ktoś musiał nagłośnić tę historię.

source_text: I thought we were partners.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I thought we were partners.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I thought we were partners."

translation: Myślałem, że byliśmy partnerami.

source_text: Are you kidding me? You’ve given me plenty of content to work with.

structure.raw_value: KiHaOp.Are you kidding me? You’ve given me plenty of content to work with.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOp.Are you kidding me? You’ve given me plenty of content to work with."

translation: Żartujesz? Dostarczyłeś mi mnóstwo materiału.

source_text: And this is how you treat me?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.And this is how you treat me?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.And this is how you treat me?"

translation: I tak mnie traktujesz?

source_text: I’m making you a star. People will love it.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.I’m making you a star. People will love it.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.I’m making you a star. People will love it."

translation: Robię z ciebie gwiazdę. Ludzie to pokochają.

source_text: I lost my job.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I lost my job.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I lost my job."

translation: Straciłem pracę.

source_text: Sorry to hear that, but you should be here with me.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Sorry to hear that, but you should be here with me.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Sorry to hear that, but you should be here with me."

translation: Współczuję, ale powinieneś być tu ze mną.

source_text: You want me working at Channel 4?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You want me working at Channel 4?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You want me working at Channel 4?"

translation: Chcesz, żebym pracował w Channel 4?

source_text: Paul wants it too. You’re a natural for this work.

structure.raw_value: KiHaEx.Paul wants it too. You’re a natural for this work.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaEx.Paul wants it too. You’re a natural for this work."

translation: Paul też tego chce. Masz naturalny talent do tej roboty.

source_text: I’m a detective, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’m a detective, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’m a detective, Kimberly."

translation: Jestem detektywem, Kimberly.

source_text: Not anymore, it sounds like.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Not anymore, it sounds like.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Not anymore, it sounds like."

translation: Podobno już nie.

source_text: Calm down, 1Hero. I’m only teasing you.

structure.raw_value: KiAnDe.Calm down, 1Hero. I’m only teasing you.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnDe.Calm down, 1Hero. I’m only teasing you."

translation: Spokojnie, 1Hero. Tylko cię drażnię.

source_text: That job meant the world to me!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.That job meant the world to me!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.That job meant the world to me!"

translation: Ta praca znaczyła dla mnie wszystko!

source_text: I’m sorry… I didn’t realize…

structure.raw_value: KiSaOp.I’m sorry… I didn’t realize…
structure.script_literal: "KiSaOp.I’m sorry… I didn’t realize…"

translation: Przepraszam… Nie zdawałam sobie sprawy…

source_text: But the offer stands. You’ll make a lot more money here.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.But the offer stands. You’ll make a lot more money here.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.But the offer stands. You’ll make a lot more money here."

translation: Ale oferta nadal stoi. Zarobisz tu znacznie więcej.

source_text: I… I can’t. I’ve got something else going on.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I… I can’t. I’ve got something else going on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I… I can’t. I’ve got something else going on."

translation: Ja… Ja nie mogę. Mam coś innego na głowie.

source_text: Really? Private detective work?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Really? Private detective work?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Really? Private detective work?"

translation: Naprawdę? Prywatne śledztwo?

source_text: Any details you care to share?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Any details you care to share?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Any details you care to share?"

translation: Chcesz zdradzić jakieś szczegóły?

source_text: See ya around, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.See ya around, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.See ya around, Kimberly."

translation: Do zobaczenia, Kimberly.

source_text: Do you still want updates about our audio transmitters?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Do you still want updates about our audio transmitters?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Do you still want updates about our audio transmitters?"

translation: Nadal chcesz aktualizacje o naszych nadajnikach audio?

source_text: … I want to stay in the loop.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.… I want to stay in the loop.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.… I want to stay in the loop."

translation: … Chcę być na bieżąco.

source_text: You’re still on the case, aren’t you?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.You’re still on the case, aren’t you?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.You’re still on the case, aren’t you?"

translation: Nadal prowadzisz sprawę, prawda?

source_text: Goodbye, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Goodbye, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Goodbye, Kimberly."

translation: Do widzenia, Kimberly.

source_text: 1Hero? Where is Melissa?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.1Hero? Where is Melissa?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.1Hero? Where is Melissa?"

translation: 1Hero? Gdzie jest Melissa?

source_text: She must still be interrogating one of Duncan’s goons.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.She must still be interrogating one of Duncan’s goons.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.She must still be interrogating one of Duncan’s goons."

translation: Pewnie wciąż przesłuchuje któregoś z ludzi Duncana.

source_text: I hope she hurries up. We want to air the segment tonight and a live interview will do wonders for ratings.

structure.raw_value: KiWoOp.I hope she hurries up. We want to air the segment tonight and a live interview will do wonders for ratings.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoOp.I hope she hurries up. We want to air the segment tonight and a live interview will do wonders for ratings."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że się pospieszy. Chcemy wyemitować segment dziś wieczorem, a wywiad na żywo świetnie podbije oglądalność.

source_text: This is the big story.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.This is the big story.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.This is the big story."

translation: To wielka sprawa.

source_text: It’s the start of something even bigger. You know that.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.It’s the start of something even bigger. You know that.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.It’s the start of something even bigger. You know that."

translation: To początek czegoś jeszcze większego. Wiesz o tym.

source_text: Don’t be so quick to trust Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Don’t be so quick to trust Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Don’t be so quick to trust Lillian."

translation: Nie ufaj tak szybko Lillian.

source_text: Why wouldn’t I?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Why wouldn’t I?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Why wouldn’t I?"

translation: Czemu miałabym nie ufać?

source_text: Are you kidding me? She’s up to something.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Are you kidding me? She’s up to something.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Are you kidding me? She’s up to something."

translation: Żartujesz? Coś kombinuje.

source_text: She seems nice to me. Plus, I get access to the story of the century.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.She seems nice to me. Plus, I get access to the story of the century.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.She seems nice to me. Plus, I get access to the story of the century."

translation: Wydaje mi się miła. Poza tym mam dostęp do historii stulecia.

source_text: Go change, 1Hero. I’ll meet you on set.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Go change, 1Hero. I’ll meet you on set.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Go change, 1Hero. I’ll meet you on set."

translation: Idź się przebierz, 1Hero. Spotkamy się na planie.

source_text: I better be careful about how this plays out. I need to paint us as heroes to save our jobs, but I don’t want to piss off Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I better be careful about how this plays out. I need to paint us as heroes to save our jobs, but I don’t want to piss off Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I better be careful about how this plays out. I need to paint us as heroes to save our jobs, but I don’t want to piss off Andrea."

translation: Lepiej uważam, jak to rozegrać. Muszę przedstawić nas jako bohaterów, by ratować posady, ale nie chcę wkurzyć Andrei.

source_text: Good job, 1Hero. We’ll air the segment Sunday night.

structure.raw_value: PlHaEx.Good job, 1Hero. We’ll air the segment Sunday night.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaEx.Good job, 1Hero. We’ll air the segment Sunday night."

translation: Dobra robota, 1Hero. Wyemitujemy segment w niedzielny wieczór.

source_text: People are going to love the heist angle.

structure.raw_value: PlFlOp.People are going to love the heist angle.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlOp.People are going to love the heist angle."

translation: Ludzie pokochają wątek napadu.

source_text: So you’re not going to snoop around the mansion anymore?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.So you’re not going to snoop around the mansion anymore?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.So you’re not going to snoop around the mansion anymore?"

translation: Więc nie będziesz już szperać wokół rezydencji?

source_text: As long as we have you.

structure.raw_value: PlFlDe.As long as we have you.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlDe.As long as we have you."

translation: Dopóki mamy ciebie.

source_text: I’m looking for Kimberly. I need to get something back from her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m looking for Kimberly. I need to get something back from her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m looking for Kimberly. I need to get something back from her."

translation: Szukam Kimberly. Muszę coś od niej odzyskać.

source_text: Kimberly’s gone crazy. She’s going on and on about demons and Hell. What’s going on?

structure.raw_value: PlWoEx.Kimberly’s gone crazy. She’s going on and on about demons and Hell. What’s going on?
structure.script_literal: "PlWoEx.Kimberly’s gone crazy. She’s going on and on about demons and Hell. What’s going on?"

translation: Kimberly oszalała. W kółko gada o demonach i piekle. Co się dzieje?

source_text: Can I talk to her?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Can I talk to her?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Can I talk to her?"

translation: Mogę z nią porozmawiać?

source_text: She’s pissed. I won’t let her go on the air with her acting like a crazy person…

structure.raw_value: PlWoEx.She’s pissed. I won’t let her go on the air with her acting like a crazy person…
structure.script_literal: "PlWoEx.She’s pissed. I won’t let her go on the air with her acting like a crazy person…"

translation: Jest wkurzona. Nie pozwolę jej wejść na antenę, gdy zachowuje się jak wariatka…

source_text: You can try and talk some sense into her, but I don’t know where she went.

structure.raw_value: PlWoDe.You can try and talk some sense into her, but I don’t know where she went.
structure.script_literal: "PlWoDe.You can try and talk some sense into her, but I don’t know where she went."

translation: Możesz spróbować przemówić jej do rozsądku, ale nie wiem, dokąd poszła.

source_text: Maybe you can salvage this situation… Bring us the stolen painting and you go live with it.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.Maybe you can salvage this situation… Bring us the stolen painting and you go live with it.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.Maybe you can salvage this situation… Bring us the stolen painting and you go live with it."

translation: Może da się uratować sytuację… Przynieś nam skradziony obraz, a wejdziesz na żywo z nim.

source_text: No way! I’m not a news broadcaster.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.No way! I’m not a news broadcaster.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.No way! I’m not a news broadcaster."

translation: Nie ma mowy! Nie jestem prezenterem.

source_text: Hey, you’re better than nothing… And people love you!

structure.raw_value: PlHaEx.Hey, you’re better than nothing… And people love you!
structure.script_literal: "PlHaEx.Hey, you’re better than nothing… And people love you!"

translation: Hej, jesteś lepszy niż nic… A ludzie cię kochają!

source_text: Let me find Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Let me find Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Let me find Kimberly."

translation: Pozwól, że znajdę Kimberly.

source_text: The clock is ticking. We may have to cancel tonight's broadcast.

structure.raw_value: PlWoEx.The clock is ticking. We may have to cancel tonight's broadcast.
structure.script_literal: "PlWoEx.The clock is ticking. We may have to cancel tonight's broadcast."

translation: Czas ucieka. Możemy musieć odwołać dzisiejszą emisję.

source_text: Good luck finding Kimberly. She stormed off after I told her she can’t go on-air with her demon story.

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.Good luck finding Kimberly. She stormed off after I told her she can’t go on-air with her demon story.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.Good luck finding Kimberly. She stormed off after I told her she can’t go on-air with her demon story."

translation: Powodzenia w szukaniu Kimberly. Wybiegła wściekła, gdy powiedziałem, że nie może wejść na antenę z historią o demonach.

source_text: Hopefully you can talk some sense into Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: PlWoOp.Hopefully you can talk some sense into Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "PlWoOp.Hopefully you can talk some sense into Kimberly."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że przemówisz Kimberly do rozsądku.

source_text: I still don’t understand how everyone got off so lightly.

structure.raw_value: PlAnDe.I still don’t understand how everyone got off so lightly.
structure.script_literal: "PlAnDe.I still don’t understand how everyone got off so lightly."

translation: Wciąż nie rozumiem, jak wszyscy uszli tak lekko.

source_text: Justice was served.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Justice was served.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Justice was served."

translation: Sprawiedliwości stało się zadość.

source_text: If you see Miss Foxx, let us know.

structure.raw_value: SeBaEx.If you see Miss Foxx, let us know.
structure.script_literal: "SeBaEx.If you see Miss Foxx, let us know."

translation: Jeśli zobaczysz pannę Foxx, daj nam znać.

source_text: I heard the news. Congratulations on being a free man.

structure.raw_value: SeBaEx.I heard the news. Congratulations on being a free man.
structure.script_literal: "SeBaEx.I heard the news. Congratulations on being a free man."

translation: Słyszałem wiadomości. Gratulacje, jesteś wolnym człowiekiem.

source_text: Everything okay, Paul? How’d it work out?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Everything okay, Paul? How’d it work out?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Everything okay, Paul? How’d it work out?"

translation: Wszystko w porządku, Paul? Jak to wyszło?

source_text: Ha! Great, like you wouldn’t believe.

structure.raw_value: PlBaDe.Ha! Great, like you wouldn’t believe.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaDe.Ha! Great, like you wouldn’t believe."

translation: Ha! Świetnie, lepiej niż myślisz.

source_text: Turns out that stunt you and Kim pulled was a big hit and brought in great ratings.

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx.Turns out that stunt you and Kim pulled was a big hit and brought in great ratings.
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx.Turns out that stunt you and Kim pulled was a big hit and brought in great ratings."

translation: Okazuje się, że ta sztuczka, którą wykręciliście z Kim, była hitem i przyniosła świetną oglądalność.

source_text: The fines will be a few million, but the profits are closing in on a hundred mil!

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.The fines will be a few million, but the profits are closing in on a hundred mil!
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.The fines will be a few million, but the profits are closing in on a hundred mil!"

translation: Kary wyniosą kilka milionów, ale zyski zbliżają się do stu baniek!

source_text: That’s good, right?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.That’s good, right?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.That’s good, right?"

translation: To dobrze, prawda?

source_text: Never in my many years of producing would I have expected porn on TV to be met with such enthusiasm.

structure.raw_value: PlBaDe.Never in my many years of producing would I have expected porn on TV to be met with such enthusiasm.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaDe.Never in my many years of producing would I have expected porn on TV to be met with such enthusiasm."

translation: Przez wszystkie moje lata jako producent nigdy nie spodziewałem się, że porno w TV spotka się z takim entuzjazmem.

source_text: Perhaps the world is changing.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Perhaps the world is changing.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Perhaps the world is changing."

translation: Może świat się zmienia.

source_text: I hear you got Andrea’s old mansion.

structure.raw_value: PlFrDe.I hear you got Andrea’s old mansion.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrDe.I hear you got Andrea’s old mansion."

translation: Słyszę, że dostałeś starą rezydencję Andrei.

source_text: I managed to swing it, yeah. It’s a great place.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I managed to swing it, yeah. It’s a great place.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I managed to swing it, yeah. It’s a great place."

translation: Udało się, tak. Świetne miejsce.

source_text: Uh huh, yeah. Really great for a detective.

structure.raw_value: PlBaDe.Uh huh, yeah. Really great for a detective.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaDe.Uh huh, yeah. Really great for a detective."

translation: Mhm, tak. Naprawdę świetne dla detektywa.

source_text: Detectives must make out better than I thought.

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx.Detectives must make out better than I thought.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx.Detectives must make out better than I thought."

translation: Detektywi muszą zarabiać lepiej, niż myślałem.

source_text: I might know a thing or two about smart investing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I might know a thing or two about smart investing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I might know a thing or two about smart investing."

translation: Może znam się trochę na mądrym inwestowaniu.

source_text: Right, smart investing. You’ll have to show me some of your tricks.
